title: The Aesthetic of RE-RENDER: Why Brutalism Matters
excerpt: How we combine high-end fashion with modern design for the web.
author: IFHAM WANI
content:
In a world of basic templates, good design is hard to find. At RE-RENDER, we believe that your website should be more than just a page—it should be an experience.

Our Design Style

Our style is a reaction against boring, generic websites. It is about big fonts, unique textures, and showing things as they are.

"Complexity is fine, as long as it's intentional."

We use high-contrast palettes and monospace fonts not just for style, but to emphasize the technical nature of our work.

title: Optimizing LUTs for Cinematic Narrative
excerpt: A technical guide on color grading with RE-RENDER PowerGrades and LUTs to achieve that professional lo-fi look.
author: ASSET DEPT
content:
Color is the soul of your footage. When we designed our latest LUT pack, we focused on skin-tone preservation while pushing the shadows into that characteristic deep green/blue cinematic space.

Exposure is Key

Standard LUTs often break when the exposure is off by even a half stop. Our PowerGrades are built node-by-node in DaVinci Resolve to allow for infinite flexibility.
